products.name: Natural Gas Compression Services
products.description: Provision of engineered compression services using a fleet of compression units to enable the processing and transportation of natural gas through pipelines and to support production at oil and gas wells. Services include engineering, design, installation, operation, maintenance, and repair of compression units, delivered under fixed-fee contracts. Requires physical assets, technical field labor, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Crude Oil Artificial Lift Compression Services (Gas Lift)
products.description: Provision of compression services for gas lift applications, where natural gas is injected into oil wells to enhance crude oil production. Delivered using specialized compression units and technical field services, primarily for horizontal wells in shale plays. Requires physical equipment and in-person technical labor.

products.name: Natural Gas Treating Services
products.description: Provision of natural gas treating services such as carbon dioxide and hydrogen sulfide removal, cooling, and dehydration, using owned and operated treating equipment for natural gas producers and midstream companies. Requires specialized physical equipment and technical operation.

products.name: Compression Equipment Manufacturing for Third Parties
products.description: Manufacture of compression units at specialized facilities, supplying both internal fleet needs and third-party customers. Involves physical manufacturing and assembly of compression equipment to customer specifications.

firms.firm: KKR Real Estate Finance Trust Inc.

products.name: Transitional Senior Commercial Real Estate Loans
products.description: Origination and acquisition of floating-rate, first-priority mortgage loans secured by institutional-quality commercial real estate properties. These loans are typically shorter-term, require a balloon payment at maturity, and are delivered through direct lending and syndication to experienced sponsors.

products.name: Mezzanine Loans
products.description: Origination and acquisition of subordinated loans secured by a pledge of equity interests in the mortgage borrower, subordinate to senior loans but senior to equity. These are structured and delivered as part of the capital stack for CRE sponsors, often retained after syndicating senior positions.

products.name: Preferred Equity Investments
products.description: Provision of preferred equity capital to CRE owners, subordinate to mortgage and mezzanine loans but senior to common equity. These investments pay a preferred return from property cash flow and may allow the provider to effect a change of control upon default.

products.name: CMBS B-Piece Investments
products.description: Acquisition of below investment-grade bonds (BB-rated, B-rated, unrated) in new issue commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) securitizations. These are typically held through maturity and provide exposure to pools of CRE loans, with first-loss risk and regulatory holding requirements.

products.name: Other Real Estate Securities
products.description: Investment in real estate-related securities such as CMBS (other than B-Pieces), collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) backed by real estate debt, and debt securities of other REITs or real estate entities. These are acquired for portfolio diversification and yield, not for control.

products.name: Rain and Snowfall Enhancement Services
products.description: RET develops, manufactures, installs, and operates ground-based atmospheric enhancement by ionization (AEI) systems to increase rainfall and snowfall. These services are delivered via proprietary hardware arrays (WETA platform) and associated software, and are provided to governmental and commercial clients under multi-year contracts. The systems are physically manufactured, installed on client or RET-controlled land, and operated remotely or locally, with ongoing monitoring and data collection.

products.name: Fog Mitigation Services
products.description: RET offers fog mitigation services using its WETA platform, applying AEI technology to dissipate fog in targeted areas. These services are in pilot and early commercialization stages, involving installation and operation of hardware systems to improve visibility for clients such as airports and transportation infrastructure operators.

products.name: Licensing and Channel Partnerships for Water Generation Technologies
products.description: RET plans to license and act as a channel partner for additional water generation technologies beyond its proprietary AEI systems. This involves commercializing third-party or acquired water generation solutions to its established client base, leveraging its sales and operational infrastructure.

products.name: Water Management and Conservation Consulting Solutions
products.description: RET provides consulting and solutions related to water conservation and management, leveraging its expertise in atmospheric enhancement and water technologies. These services are offered to governmental and commercial clients seeking to improve water availability and resiliency.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering, Processing, Treating, and Transportation Services
products.description: Comprehensive midstream services that include gathering raw natural gas from wellheads, compressing, treating to remove contaminants, processing to separate into residue gas and NGLs, and transporting the processed gas to end-use markets via pipelines. These services require extensive regulated pipeline infrastructure, physical processing plants, and in-person operational management.

products.name: Crude Oil and Condensate Gathering, Stabilization, Treating, and Transportation Services
products.description: Services involving the gathering of crude oil and condensate from production sites, stabilization and treating at central facilities, and transportation to terminals, storage, pipelines, or refineries. This business line relies on physical infrastructure such as pipelines, stabilization facilities, and storage tanks, and is subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Gathering, Processing, Fractionation, and Transportation Services
products.description: Midstream services for NGLs, including gathering mixed NGL streams from processing plants, fractionating them into marketable products, and transporting via dedicated NGL pipelines to storage or end markets. This requires specialized pipelines, fractionation facilities, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Produced Water Gathering, Recycling, Treating, Supply, and Disposal Services
products.description: Integrated water management services that gather produced water from oil and gas operations, treat and recycle it for reuse, supply treated water back to customers, and dispose of excess water via permitted injection wells. This business line involves a network of pipelines, recycling/treatment facilities, and regulated disposal wells.

products.name: Residue Gas, NGLs, and Condensate Marketing Services
products.description: Marketing and sales of residue gas, NGLs, and condensate produced from processing operations, both on behalf of the company and its customers, under certain contracts. This is a commercial activity leveraging the company’s processed product streams and market access, rather than physical infrastructure alone.

products.name: Cardiometabolic Programs
products.description: A suite of virtual care programs for chronic conditions including diabetes prevention, diabetes management, hypertension, high cholesterol, and weight management, delivered through a human-led, technology-enabled platform with personalized coaching, connected devices, and digital tools. These programs are provided to members via employers, health plans, PBMs, and health systems.

products.name: GLP-1 Care Track and Medication Management
products.description: A virtual care track embedded within cardiometabolic programs to support members using GLP-1 and other anti-obesity medications, including education, behavioral support, and, starting in 2026, prescribing and medication management by licensed providers through a scalable digital model.

products.name: Musculoskeletal (MSK) Virtual Physical Therapy Program
products.description: A digital program connecting members with licensed physical therapists for virtual consultation and treatment of musculoskeletal conditions, including video visits, asynchronous chat, personalized exercise plans, and computer vision-based form analysis, delivered via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing Services
products.description: Comprehensive contract manufacturing for a wide range of electronic and mechanical products, including design, engineering, precision plastic molding, sheet metal fabrication, printed circuit board assembly, and complete product assembly. Services are delivered through vertically integrated, multinational facilities using both manual and automated processes.

products.name: Product Design and Engineering Services
products.description: Design and engineering support for customer products, including research, development, prototype design, and optimization of new product designs and production processes. Delivered by in-house engineering teams using computer-aided design and advanced engineering expertise.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate, including both owner-occupied and non-owner occupied properties, as well as acquisition, development, and construction (ADC) loans. These loans are physically underwritten, require collateral, and are managed through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to businesses for working capital, equipment purchases, accounts receivable financing, and other corporate purposes. These loans are underwritten based on business cash flow and collateral, and require in-person relationship management.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) Lending
products.description: Origination of government-guaranteed loans to small businesses under the SBA Preferred Lender Program, including in-house processing and sale of guaranteed portions. Requires regulatory compliance and specialized underwriting.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans including home equity lines of credit, personal lines of credit, term loans, auto loans, and personal loans. These are underwritten based on individual creditworthiness and delivered through branches and digital channels.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering of business and personal checking accounts, savings and money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and retirement accounts. Delivered through physical branches and a digital banking platform, with FDIC insurance and cash management features.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Provision of online and mobile banking platforms for both personal and business accounts, including remote deposit capture and digital account management. Delivered digitally and available nationwide for certain products.

products.name: Treasury Management and Cash Management Services
products.description: Suite of services for business clients including cash management, business sweep accounts, lockbox, account reconciliation, merchant card services, and Automated Clearing House (ACH) origination. Delivered through a combination of digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Municipal Finance Lending
products.description: Lending to municipalities by purchasing municipal debt on the public market and through direct purchase issuance, managed by a dedicated subsidiary. Requires specialized underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Insurance Referral Services
products.description: Referral program providing access to insurance products and services through a third-party insurance broker, generating fee income for the bank. Delivered via partnership rather than direct underwriting.

products.name: Commercial Health Benefit Plans
products.description: Comprehensive managed care health insurance products for employer groups and individuals, including PPO, HMO, CDHP, indemnity, and POS plans, delivered via network-based risk-based and fee-based arrangements. These plans are administered through physical and digital channels and require regulatory compliance and provider network management.

products.name: Medicare Plans
products.description: Medicare Advantage, Special Needs Plans, Medicare-Medicaid Plans, Medicare Supplement, and Medicare Part D prescription drug plans for seniors and eligible individuals, delivered through managed care and supplemental insurance models, requiring regulatory compliance and integration with federal programs.

products.name: Medicaid and State-Sponsored Health Plans
products.description: Managed care health insurance products and administrative services for Medicaid, CHIP, TANF, LTSS, and other state-sponsored programs, serving low-income, high-risk, and special needs populations, requiring compliance with state and federal regulations and coordination with public agencies.

products.name: Federal Employee Health Benefit Plans (FEP)
products.description: Health insurance plans and administrative services for U.S. federal government employees and their dependents, delivered through managed care and network-based models, requiring compliance with federal program requirements.

products.name: Pharmacy Benefit Management and Pharmacy Services
products.description: Comprehensive pharmacy benefit management services, including home delivery and specialty pharmacies, claims adjudication, formulary management, pharmacy networks, rebate administration, and infusion services, delivered through CarelonRx and requiring integration with health plans and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Dental Insurance Plans
products.description: Dental benefit plans offered on both risk-based and fee-based models, providing access to dental provider networks and national dental discounts, requiring network management and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Vision Insurance Plans
products.description: Vision benefit plans offered on both risk-based and fee-based models, providing coverage for eye exams, corrective eyewear, and access to national optical networks, requiring network management and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Supplemental Health Insurance
products.description: Insurance products covering specific conditions or circumstances, such as accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity, designed to complement traditional medical coverage and address unexpected healthcare expenses.

products.name: Stop Loss Insurance
products.description: Stop loss insurance products for self-funded employer groups, providing financial protection against high medical claims, delivered through underwriting and claims management services.

products.name: Administrative Services for Self-Funded Plans
products.description: Administrative services for employer groups and other entities operating self-funded health plans, including claims processing, provider network access, medical management, care management, wellness programs, actuarial services, and other administrative support, delivered through digital and human resources.

products.name: Behavioral Health Services
products.description: Comprehensive behavioral health management services, including clinical services, network administration, case management, and digital support, delivered through Carelon Behavioral Health and integrated with medical and pharmacy benefits.

products.name: Care Management and Wellness Programs
products.description: Integrated care management and wellness programs, including digital engagement, nurse lines, maternity and chronic condition management, and health-related social needs support, delivered through digital platforms and clinical staff.

products.name: Home and Virtual Care Services
products.description: Personalized care delivery services for chronic and complex populations, including home health, post-acute care, virtual care, and palliative care, delivered through Carelon Health and Carelon Post Acute Solutions, leveraging clinical staff and digital platforms.

products.name: Healthcare Data Analytics and Insights Services
products.description: Healthcare analytics, payment integrity, subrogation, clinical data exchange, reporting, and IT services, delivered through Carelon Insights and HealthOS platform, supporting both internal and external customers with digital and data-driven solutions.

products.name: Medicare Administrative Operations
products.description: Administrative services for the federal Medicare program, including fiscal intermediary, carrier, and Medicare administrative contractor roles for Parts A and B, involving claims processing and provider reimbursement for government programs.

products.name: Azetukalner (Kv7 Potassium Channel Opener) Therapeutics
products.description: Azetukalner is a novel, orally administered small-molecule Kv7 potassium channel opener developed and delivered as a pharmaceutical drug for the treatment of neurological and psychiatric disorders, including epilepsy (focal onset seizures and primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures), major depressive disorder, and bipolar depression. It is manufactured using synthetic chemical processes and delivered as an oral medication, subject to regulatory approval.

products.name: Next Generation Ion Channel Modulators for Pain
products.description: Small-molecule therapeutics targeting potassium (Kv7) and sodium (Nav1.7) channels for the treatment of acute and chronic pain, developed through proprietary drug discovery and delivered as oral pharmaceuticals. These are in early-stage clinical development and require chemical synthesis and clinical validation.

products.name: Partnered Sodium Channel Inhibitor Therapeutics for Epilepsy (with Neurocrine Biosciences)
products.description: Sodium channel inhibitor drugs (e.g., NBI-921352, targeting Nav1.2/1.6) for the treatment of epilepsy, developed under a license and collaboration agreement with Neurocrine Biosciences. These are advanced through clinical development and, if approved, will be manufactured and commercialized by the partner, with Xenon receiving royalties and milestone payments.

products.name: E-commerce Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform (website and mobile app) enabling third-party and first-party sales of a wide assortment of goods across categories such as electronics, apparel, home goods, automotive, toys, books, and consumer packaged goods. Includes cross-border trade and is supported by proprietary technology and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Classifieds Listings
products.description: Online classified advertising service for vehicles, properties, and services, where users pay placing fees to list items. Delivered digitally via the platform, distinct from the main marketplace as it does not charge final value fees.

products.name: Logistics and Fulfillment Services
products.description: Integrated logistics solution (Mercado Envios) offering warehousing, fulfillment, shipping, and last-mile delivery for marketplace sellers, utilizing fulfillment centers, cross-docking, partner stores, and a transportation network including dedicated aircraft and third-party carriers.

products.name: Digital Advertising Solutions
products.description: Advertising platform (Mercado Ads) providing on-platform and off-platform ad formats (sponsored listings, banners, video ads) for sellers and brands, leveraging first-party data and digital delivery to target audiences across the ecosystem.

products.name: Digital Payments Processing
products.description: Digital payment infrastructure (Mercado Pago) for online and offline transactions, including payment processing for e-commerce, POS devices, QR code payments, and digital accounts for consumers and merchants. Delivered via proprietary software and hardware.

products.name: Consumer and Merchant Lending
products.description: Credit products including merchant and consumer loans, credit cards, and asset-backed loans, originated and managed through proprietary risk models and digital channels, available both on and off the marketplace.

products.name: Debit and Prepaid Card Issuance
products.description: Issuance of prepaid and debit cards linked to Mercado Pago digital accounts, enabling users to spend and withdraw balances digitally and physically. Cards are managed and distributed through digital channels and partnerships with financial institutions.

products.name: Insurance Products
products.description: Distribution and management of insurance products such as extended warranties, personal accident, theft, and damage policies, offered digitally through partnerships with insurance companies and managed via the platform.

products.name: Savings and Investment Products
products.description: Digital savings and investment solutions, including remunerated digital accounts, certificates of deposit, and investment funds, allowing users to earn returns and manage investments through the Mercado Pago platform.

products.name: Cryptocurrency and Stablecoin Services
products.description: Digital asset services enabling users to buy, hold, and sell selected cryptocurrencies and stablecoins (including Meli Dólar) through the Mercado Pago digital account, with custody and blockchain infrastructure provided by partners.

products.name: Loyalty and Subscription Programs
products.description: Tiered loyalty program (Meli+) offering ecosystem-wide benefits such as enhanced shipping, cashback, installment options, and bundled access to third-party streaming services, delivered digitally to users across the platform.

products.name: Ad-Supported Video Streaming
products.description: Advertising-based video on demand (AVOD) streaming service (Mercado Play) offering third-party content to users via apps and connected TVs, monetized through video advertising and revenue-sharing agreements with content providers.

products.name: Syringe Products and Drug-Delivery Systems
products.description: Sharps Technology markets and distributes a portfolio of conventional and safety syringes, as well as related drug-delivery systems, to hospitals, clinics, healthcare providers, and medical supply organizations. These products are manufactured to comply with regulatory and quality standards and are delivered through physical distribution channels.

products.name: Third-Party Medical Device Distribution
products.description: The company distributes complementary and synergistic medical products from established third-party manufacturers to its healthcare customer base, expanding its distribution platform beyond its own manufactured products. This involves physical distribution and sales of externally sourced medical devices.

products.name: SOL Digital Asset Treasury Management and Staking
products.description: Sharps Technology manages a large treasury of SOL (the native digital asset of the Solana blockchain), generating revenue primarily through price appreciation and protocol-native staking rewards. This involves digital asset management, staking through validators, and yield generation via blockchain infrastructure.

products.name: Apparel
products.description: Extensive collections of men's, women's, and children's clothing, including sportswear, tailored clothing, and activewear, designed and marketed under various Ralph Lauren brands. Products are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed globally through retail, wholesale, and digital channels.

products.name: Footwear & Accessories
products.description: A broad range of footwear and accessories for men, women, and children, including shoes, boots, sneakers, handbags, luggage, belts, eyewear, watches, jewelry, scarves, hats, gloves, and umbrellas, produced by third-party manufacturers and sold through retail, wholesale, and digital channels.

products.name: Home Products
products.description: Home collections including bed and bath lines, furniture, fabric and wall coverings, lighting, dining, floor coverings, and giftware, designed under Ralph Lauren brands and produced by third-party suppliers for sale through retail, wholesale, and licensing channels.

products.name: Fragrances
products.description: A variety of men's, women's, and gender-neutral fragrances developed in partnership with licensing partners, manufactured and distributed globally under Ralph Lauren brands through retail, wholesale, and digital channels.

products.name: Hospitality Services
products.description: Operation of branded restaurants and cafés, including The Polo Bar, RL Restaurant, Ralph's, The Bar at Ralph Lauren, and Ralph's Coffee, providing experiential dining and brand engagement in major cities worldwide.

products.name: Upscale Extended-Stay Hotels
products.description: Ownership and leasing of upscale extended-stay hotels, primarily under brands such as Residence Inn by Marriott, Homewood Suites by Hilton, Home2 Suites by Hilton, and TownePlace Suites by Marriott. These hotels are physically constructed properties offering large suites with full kitchens or kitchenettes, amenities like complimentary breakfast, high-speed internet, and in-person guest services, targeting business travelers and extended assignments.

products.name: Premium-Branded Select-Service Hotels
products.description: Ownership and leasing of premium-branded select-service hotels under brands such as Courtyard by Marriott, Hampton Inn, Hilton Garden Inn, SpringHill Suites, Hyatt Place, and Embassy Suites. These are physically constructed hotel properties offering a range of amenities including breakfast, internet, and room cleaning, but with more limited services than full-service hotels, targeting both business and leisure travelers.

products.name: Hotel Real Estate Investment and Leasing
products.description: Acquisition, ownership, and leasing of hotel properties to taxable REIT subsidiaries, which then engage third-party management companies to operate the hotels. This involves physical real estate assets and structured leasing arrangements, rather than direct hotel operations.

products.name: Selective Investment in Hotel Debt
products.description: Occasional investment in debt collateralized by hotel properties, with the intent to acquire ownership of the underlying hotel property in the near term. This is a financial product involving capital investment and debt instruments, not physical goods or direct hotel operations.

products.name: Occupational Health Services
products.description: Comprehensive services focused on the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of work-related injuries and illnesses, delivered primarily through physical occupational health centers and onsite employer clinics, supported by licensed clinicians and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Employer Services
products.description: A suite of services for employers including physical examinations, drug and alcohol screening, clinical testing, vaccinations, preventive care, and consultative services, delivered at occupational health centers, onsite clinics, or employer worksites, requiring in-person clinical labor and compliance with regulatory standards.

products.name: Onsite Health Clinic Services
products.description: Customizable occupational health and employer-sponsored primary care services delivered directly at employer worksites, including injury care, primary care, urgent care, preventive care, physical therapy, and wellness services, utilizing both permanent and mobile clinics staffed by medical professionals.

products.name: Telemedicine for Occupational Health
products.description: Digital telemedicine platform providing remote diagnosis and treatment of work-related injuries and illnesses, as well as employer services and behavioral health, available 24/7 via video technology, leveraging centralized clinical teams and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Services
products.description: Onsite and clinic-based physical therapy, occupational therapy, and athletic training services for work-related injuries and musculoskeletal conditions, delivered by licensed therapists to expedite recovery and return to work, often integrated with injury care.

products.name: Pharmacy Services for Occupational Health
products.description: Distribution and dispensing of repackaged medications to occupational health centers for immediate patient access, managed through an accredited pharmacy operation and compliant with state dispensing regulations.

products.name: Medical Compliance Administration Services
products.description: Third-party administration and management of employer substance abuse testing programs, including program management, monitoring, and regulatory compliance, delivered by specialized professionals using proprietary processes and technology.

products.name: Consumer Health and Urgent Care Services
products.description: Clinic-based urgent care and consumer health services for minor illnesses and injuries, laboratory tests, x-rays, immunizations, and infectious disease screenings, provided to individual consumers outside of employer or workers’ compensation programs.

products.name: Card Issuing and Processing Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, open API platform enabling customers to build, launch, and manage debit, prepaid, credit, virtual, and physical card programs, with real-time transaction processing and extensive configurability. Delivered digitally and integrated with issuing banks and card networks.

products.name: Banking and Money Movement Services
products.description: A suite of digital banking features including savings and demand deposit accounts, direct deposit, ACH, cash loads, bill pay, instant funding, and fee-free ATMs, provided through issuing bank partners and integrated into customer applications.

products.name: Card Program Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive management of card programs, including compliance, chargebacks, dispute resolution, reconciliation, card fulfillment, and BIN sponsorship, delivered as managed services to customers launching card programs.

products.name: Value Added Payment Services
products.description: A set of digital services enhancing the payment experience, such as tokenization, real-time decisioning and fraud management, digital banking features, and customer experience tools, integrated via APIs.

products.name: Portfolio Migration Services
products.description: Automated tools and operational processes to migrate existing card programs from other platforms to Marqeta’s platform, minimizing disruption and aligning data for a smooth transition.

products.name: Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) Enablement (Marqeta Hub)
products.description: A digital solution that integrates and distributes BNPL payment options within payment apps and wallets, enabling card issuers and BNPL providers to offer flexible, personalized installment payment methods to consumers.

products.name: White Label and UI/UX Toolkits
products.description: Pre-built UI components and white label mobile applications that allow customers to quickly launch branded cardholder experiences integrated with Marqeta’s platform, reducing development time and resources.

products.name: Light Vehicle Driveline and Power Systems
products.description: Manufacture and supply of axles, driveshafts, transmissions (ICE, hybrid, and electric), e-Axle systems, e-Transmission systems, inverters, electric motors, controllers, and related sealing and thermal management products for light vehicles. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to OEMs globally.

products.name: Commercial Vehicle Driveline and Power Systems
products.description: Manufacture and supply of axles, driveshafts, transmissions (hybrid and electric), e-Axle systems, e-Transmission systems, inverters, electric motors, controllers, and related sealing and thermal management products for commercial vehicles such as trucks and buses. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to OEMs globally.

products.name: Vehicle Sealing and Thermal Management Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and supply of sealing and thermal management products including ICE sealing and thermal, e-Sealing, e-Thermal cooling systems, battery cooling, electronics cooling, hydrogen fuel cell cooling, and new power industrial cooling for both light and commercial vehicles. These are physically produced and integrated into vehicle systems.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination and purchase of commercial real estate loans nationwide, secured by various property types such as retail, industrial, hospitality, multifamily, and office. Loans are underwritten and serviced in-house, and may be originated or acquired at a discount.

products.name: Small Business Lending (SBA Loans)
products.description: Origination of loans to small businesses nationwide, primarily through the SBA 7(a) program, which provides partial government guarantees. products.description: Origination of loans to consumers and businesses in Maine, including residential mortgages, home equity loans, commercial real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, and consumer loans such as auto and recreational vehicle loans. Loans may be held for investment or sold in the secondary market.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of residential mortgage loans secured by one- to four-family properties, primarily in Maine. Loans may be held for investment or sold in the secondary market, and include home equity loans and lines of credit.

products.name: Deposit Products and Services
products.description: Provision of a full line of deposit products, including demand deposit, NOW, money market, savings, and certificate of deposit accounts, through physical branches in Maine and the nationwide online platform ableBanking. Includes digital banking services such as online and mobile banking.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a broad range of loans to business entities, including commercial business loans, commercial real estate loans (owner-occupied and non-owner occupied), construction loans, revolving lines of credit, and letters of credit. These are delivered through in-person relationship banking and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Retail Lending
products.description: Offers loans to individuals for personal uses such as home improvement, automobiles, and residential mortgages. These are provided through branch networks and require in-person service, financial capital, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Accounts Receivable and Inventory Financing
products.description: Through Magnolia Financial, provides accounts receivable financing and factoring, inventory financing, and purchase order financing to businesses, primarily in the southeastern United States. Delivered via specialized business finance operations and requires financial capital and risk management.

products.name: Used Car Floor-Plan Financing
products.description: Provides floor-plan lines of credit to small used car dealers for inventory purchases, administered through the CarBucks division. Requires specialized lending procedures and financial capital.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a full range of deposit accounts and services to retail and commercial customers, including checking, savings, money market, time deposits, certificates of deposit, and IRAs. Delivered through branch network and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Brokered Deposit Services
products.description: Provides brokered deposits to customers, including access to FDIC insurance on large deposits through CDARS and ICS programs. Requires coordination with external brokers and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Investment Products and Wealth Management
products.description: Offers non-FDIC insured investment and insurance products, including mutual funds, annuities, long-term care insurance, life insurance, company retirement plans, and financial planning services through FB Wealth Management Services. Delivered via in-person advisors and digital channels, requiring licensing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Credit Card and Debit Card Services
products.description: Issues credit and debit cards to customers, enabling electronic payments and access to funds. Delivered through partnerships with payment networks and requires secure digital infrastructure.

products.name: Electronic Banking and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides internet banking, mobile banking, mobile check deposit, cash management, remote deposit capture, bank-by-phone, and ATM access. Delivered digitally and through physical infrastructure, requiring technology investment and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Safe Deposit Box Rentals
products.description: Offers safe deposit box rentals to customers for secure storage of valuables. Delivered through branch network and requires physical infrastructure.

products.name: Property and Casualty Insurance Placement
products.description: Offers placement of property and casualty insurance to customers through contractual relationships with insurance providers. Delivered via in-person and digital channels, requiring licensing and compliance.

products.name: Specialty Insurance Products
products.description: A broad range of specialty insurance products including professional lines, property, liability, cyber, marine and aviation, accident and health, and credit and political risk, delivered primarily through wholesale and retail brokers, MGAs, and MGUs. These products are underwritten globally and require significant underwriting expertise, regulatory compliance, and claims management infrastructure.

products.name: Specialty Reinsurance Products
products.description: Reinsurance solutions provided to insurance companies worldwide, covering lines such as liability, professional lines, motor, accident and health, credit and surety, agriculture, and marine. Delivered on proportional and excess of loss bases, these products require capital deployment, risk modeling, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Group Benefits and Employee Health Plans
products.description: Voluntary, limited benefit, affordable health plans and other employee benefits coverage for hourly and part-time workers and their families, delivered through AXIS Group Benefits LLC as an authorized insurance producer. Requires regulatory compliance and distribution through licensed producers.

products.name: Private Cord Blood and Cord Tissue Banking Services
products.description: Collection, processing, and cryogenic storage of umbilical cord blood and tissue stem cells for families, delivered through FDA-compliant laboratory facilities and long-term storage agreements. Requires regulated infrastructure, physical specimen handling, and ongoing storage management.

products.name: Public Cord Blood Banking Services
products.description: Collection, processing, and cryogenic storage of donated umbilical cord blood stem cells for public use, with units distributed for transplant through the National Marrow Donor Program to transplant centers worldwide. Involves regulated collection, laboratory processing, and inventory management.

products.name: PrepaCyte CB Processing System
products.description: Manufacture and sale of the PrepaCyte CB Processing System, a medical device used by cell processing laboratories to process and store total nucleated cells from human umbilical cord blood prior to banking. Requires physical manufacturing and FDA medical device compliance.

products.name: Biorepository and Cold Storage Services (ExtraVault)
products.description: Provision of cryogenic and cold storage services for biological specimens, reagents, and vaccines to third-party pharmaceutical companies and healthcare institutions, leveraging advanced inventory management and secure storage infrastructure. Delivered through dedicated facilities and digital customer portals.

products.name: Fungerp Antifungal Platform (including Ibrexafungerp and SCY-247)
products.description: A proprietary class of antifungal agents (triterpenoids) developed for the treatment and prevention of severe, drug-resistant fungal infections. Delivered as oral and intravenous formulations, these products are manufactured via semi-synthetic processes involving fermentation and chemical synthesis, and are distributed through pharmaceutical channels. Ibrexafungerp (marketed as BREXAFEMME) is approved for vulvovaginal candidiasis and recurrent vulvovaginal candidiasis, while SCY-247 is in clinical development for invasive candidiasis and prophylaxis of invasive fungal infections.

products.name: enVVe System
products.description: A minimally invasive, catheter-based, tissue-based implantable medical device system designed to treat severe deep chronic venous insufficiency (CVI) by replacing incompetent venous valves. The system includes the enVVe Valve and associated delivery and crimping accessories, and is manufactured in an ISO 13485-2016 certified facility.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail centers, industrial assets, office properties, and commercial land (primarily through urban ground leases) in Hawai‘i. Properties are owned, operated, and managed by the company, with a focus on grocery-anchored neighborhood shopping centers and industrial spaces. Delivery requires physical ownership, property management, and compliance with local regulations.

products.name: Real Estate Development and Land Sales
products.description: Development and sale of unimproved land and real estate properties, including legacy landholdings and joint venture projects. This involves entitlement, development, and monetization of land assets, requiring capital investment, regulatory approvals, and project management.

products.name: Packaged Bread Products
products.description: Manufactured fresh and frozen breads, including loaf breads, specialty breads, and small loaves, produced in company-owned bakeries and distributed via direct-store-delivery and warehouse systems to retail and foodservice customers nationwide.

products.name: Buns and Rolls
products.description: Fresh and frozen hamburger and hot dog buns, sandwich buns, and dinner rolls, produced in company bakeries and distributed through retail, foodservice, and institutional channels.

products.name: Snack Cakes and Snack Items
products.description: Manufactured snack cakes, bars, cookies, crackers, and snack bites, produced in company bakeries and by co-manufacturers, distributed through retail, vending, and foodservice channels.

products.name: Bagels, English Muffins, and Flat Breads
products.description: Produced bagels, English muffins, pitas, and flat breads in company bakeries and through acquired facilities, distributed to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Tortillas
products.description: Manufactured tortillas in company bakeries, distributed through retail and foodservice channels as part of the bakery product portfolio.

products.name: Baking Mixes
products.description: Dry baking mixes for breads, cakes, and other baked goods, produced in company facilities and by co-manufacturers, distributed to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Better-for-You and Specialty Bakery Products
products.description: Premium, organic, gluten-free, keto, and higher-protein bakery products, including breads, buns, snack bars, and crackers, produced in company bakeries and by co-manufacturers, targeting health-conscious consumers.

products.name: Store Brand (Private Label) Bakery Products
products.description: Manufactured bakery products produced for and sold under retailer brands, distributed through retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing and Co-Packing Services
products.description: Production of bakery products for third-party brands and companies, including co-packing arrangements with retail customers and other food companies.

products.name: TCR-T Therapies for Hematologic Malignancies
products.description: Allogeneic, donor-derived T cell receptor-engineered T cell (TCR-T) therapies designed to eliminate residual disease and prevent relapse in patients with hematologic (heme) malignancies undergoing allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT). These therapies are manufactured using a non-viral gene delivery system and require physical cell processing and genetic engineering in GMP facilities.

products.name: TCR-T Therapies for Solid Tumors
products.description: T cell receptor-engineered T cell (TCR-T) therapies, including multiplexed approaches, for the treatment of solid tumors. These therapies are designed to target multiple cancer-specific antigens and are being developed both as ex vivo engineered cell therapies and as in vivo engineered, off-the-shelf products. Delivery involves advanced cell engineering and may include in vivo gene delivery technologies.

products.name: TCR-T Therapies for Autoimmune Disorders
products.description: T cell receptor-engineered T cell (TCR-T) therapies and related treatment options for T cell-driven autoimmune disorders, developed using a proprietary target discovery platform. These therapies are in early-stage development and leverage genetic engineering and cell therapy manufacturing processes.

products.name: Target Discovery Platform Services (Collaborative Research)
products.description: Proprietary platform technology for identifying T cell antigens, offered to strategic partners (e.g., Amgen) for discovery of disease-relevant targets. This service involves advanced screening and analytical methods and is delivered as a collaborative research service rather than a physical product.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Provision of regulated natural gas distribution to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Pennsylvania, Maryland, and West Virginia, using extensive pipeline infrastructure and subject to state and federal regulation.

products.name: Electric Utility Services
products.description: Supply and distribution of regulated electric service to customers in northeastern Pennsylvania, utilizing transmission and distribution lines and substations, with electricity sourced from wholesale markets or other suppliers.

products.name: Retail Propane Distribution (U.S.)
products.description: Distribution and sale of propane to residential, commercial, industrial, motor fuel, agricultural, and wholesale customers across all 50 U.S. states, including delivery via bulk tanks, cylinders, and specialized programs like ACE and Cynch.

products.name: LPG Distribution (Europe)
products.description: Marketing and distribution of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in bulk and cylinders to residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural, wholesale, and autogas customers across 15 European countries, using a network of storage, logistics, and transportation assets.

products.name: Retail Energy Marketing (Natural Gas, RNG, Liquid Fuels, Electricity)
products.description: Sale of natural gas, renewable natural gas (RNG), liquid fuels, and electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in multiple U.S. states, often under fixed-price or requirements contracts, leveraging third-party utility infrastructure.

products.name: Midstream Services (Gathering, Processing, Storage, Pipelines)
products.description: Provision of natural gas gathering, processing, storage, and pipeline transportation services, including LNG and propane-air peaking, to producers, marketers, utilities, and other third parties, using owned and operated midstream infrastructure in the Marcellus and Utica Shale regions and beyond.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Production and Marketing
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of RNG production facilities, purchase of RNG from landfills and biodigesters, and resale to fleet operators and other customers, including monetization of environmental credits.

products.name: LNG Sales and Services
products.description: Production, storage, and sale of liquefied natural gas (LNG) to customers for use in vehicles, drilling rigs, and off-grid facilities, supported by owned liquefaction and storage facilities.

products.name: Solar Power Generation
products.description: Ownership and operation of solar-powered electric generation assets in select U.S. states, providing renewable electricity to the grid or customers.

products.name: Logistics and Storage Services for LPG (Europe)
products.description: Provision of logistics, storage, and related services to third-party LPG distributors in Europe, leveraging UGI International's storage facilities and transportation network.

products.name: Commercial and Mixed-Use Real Estate Development and Management
products.description: Development, redevelopment, leasing, and management of commercial and mixed-use real estate properties, including multifamily, student housing, senior living, healthcare, industrial, self-storage, hospitality, office, mixed-use, data centers, and solar projects. Properties are physically constructed or renovated and then leased to tenants or sold, requiring significant capital investment, construction management, and ongoing property management.

products.name: Real Estate-Related Lending and Investment
products.description: Origination, acquisition, and management of commercial real estate loans and mortgages, as well as investment in debt and equity securities issued by other real estate-related companies. This involves financial capital and expertise in structuring and managing real estate-backed financial instruments.

products.name: Qualified Opportunity Fund Investment Products
products.description: Offering investment products in the form of Class A units in a publicly traded qualified opportunity fund, enabling investors to access tax-advantaged real estate investments in opportunity zones. This is a financial product delivered through securities offerings and requires regulatory compliance and fund management.

products.name: Private Equity Acquisitions and Investments in Real Estate-Related Businesses
products.description: Acquisition of controlling or non-controlling interests in other qualified opportunity funds, qualified opportunity zone businesses, and private equity investments in real estate-related companies. This is a financial investment activity requiring due diligence, capital deployment, and ongoing oversight.

products.name: Online Dating Services
products.description: Digital platforms (Bumble app and Badoo app) that enable users to create profiles, match, and communicate with potential romantic partners, delivered via mobile and web apps using proprietary matching algorithms and safety features. Monetized through freemium subscriptions and in-app purchases.

products.name: Friendship and Community Connection Services
products.description: Digital platforms (Bumble For Friends app and BFF app) that facilitate platonic friend-finding, group connections, and community-building through matching algorithms, group chats, events, and collaboration tools, delivered via mobile apps. Monetized through similar freemium models as dating apps.

products.name: Digital Content Licensing
products.description: Licensing of digital creative assets including images (photographs, vectors, illustrations), video footage, music tracks, sound effects, and 3D models, delivered via a cloud-based, searchable online platform. Content is sourced from a global contributor network and distributed under royalty-free or custom licenses.

products.name: Generative AI Content
products.description: Provision of AI-generated images created from algorithms trained on ethically sourced content, delivered through model prompts on the digital platform. Customers generate custom images by entering descriptions.

products.name: Metadata Licensing for AI and Machine Learning
products.description: Licensing of metadata associated with images, footage, music, and 3D models for use in machine learning and AI model training by technology and media companies. Delivered as large-scale, licenseable datasets.

products.name: GIF Distribution and Advertising Services
products.description: Distribution and contextual advertising services using GIFs via the Giphy platform, serving as visual elements in digital conversations and advertising. Delivered through digital integration and partnerships.

products.name: Custom Content Creation and Production Services (Shutterstock Studios)
products.description: Custom, high-quality branded content creation and production services, including pre-production, live production, and post-production, delivered at scale for brands and agencies. Includes tailored creative solutions and production tools.

products.name: Online Graphic Design and Image Editing Tools
products.description: Provision of online graphic design and image editing tools (e.g., PicMonkey) enabling users to create and customize digital assets. Delivered as web-based software integrated with the content platform.

products.name: Digital Creative Asset Templates and Marketplaces
products.description: Access to digital creative asset templates and marketplaces (e.g., Envato, Placeit) offering templates for graphics, video, audio, and web design, delivered via online platforms for creators and businesses.

products.name: Customer Experience (CX) Technology Consulting and Implementation
products.description: Professional services focused on designing, configuring, integrating, and implementing customer experience technology solutions, including cloud-based and premise-based platforms, often leveraging partnerships with leading CX software vendors. Delivery is through a mix of software engineering, systems architecture, and consulting expertise.

products.name: Managed CX Technology Services
products.description: Ongoing management, support, and operation of cloud and on-premise customer experience technology platforms, including managed services for applications and infrastructure. Delivered through remote and on-site teams, leveraging proprietary and partner technologies.

products.name: Custom CX Software and Intellectual Property Solutions
products.description: Development and deployment of proprietary software and intellectual property tailored to industry-specific and custom client needs, including AI-enabled applications and integrations. Delivered digitally by software engineering teams.

products.name: CX Data and Analytics Services
products.description: Data science, engineering, analytics, and visualization services to support customer experience transformation, including AI and analytics integration. Delivered by data scientists and analytics professionals using digital tools.

products.name: CX Transformation and Strategy Consulting
products.description: Consulting services focused on customer experience transformation strategy, design, and roadmap development, leveraging industry expertise and technology insights. Delivered by CX strategists and consultants.

products.name: Omnichannel Customer Care Services
products.description: Operational and managed services delivering end-to-end customer support across digital and live interaction channels, tailored to industry-specific needs. Delivered by large-scale, geographically distributed teams using digital-first models.

products.name: Technical Support Services
products.description: Provision of technical support for client products and services, including troubleshooting and problem resolution, delivered through digital and live channels by trained associates.

products.name: Revenue Generation and Customer Acquisition Services
products.description: Services focused on customer acquisition, growth, retention, and revenue generation, including sales support and upselling, delivered through omnichannel engagement and specialized teams.

products.name: Fraud Mitigation Services
products.description: Operational services to detect, prevent, and mitigate fraud in client customer interactions, leveraging digital tools and trained personnel. Delivered as part of managed service offerings.

products.name: Back-Office Support Services
products.description: Business process outsourcing services for non-customer-facing operations such as data entry, processing, and administrative support, delivered by remote and on-site teams.

products.name: AI Operations and Data Annotation Services
products.description: Services supporting AI operations, including data annotation and labeling for machine learning and AI model development, delivered by specialized teams.
